circuit.name: Flyback PFC DCM
circuit.description: Single-stage AC-DC flyback Power Factor Correction (PFC) converter operating in Discontinuous Conduction Mode (DCM). The AC line is rectified by a diode bridge into a small high-frequency input capacitor, so the flyback primary sees the rectified line voltage. With a constant on-time (fixed duty) in DCM the input current follows the line voltage, giving natural power factor correction. Output = Vpk * D * sqrt(R_LOAD / (4 * Lm * fsw)) averaged over the line cycle. The line source starts at its peak, the windings carry RC snubbers and the bus a bleeder resistor so the solver stays well-conditioned through the line zero crossings.
